Container.Name: Mnema-Talk
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: chat voice video screen share talk team community self-hosted
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 18 and an S3 media store, each in its own container. Install them first: the postgresql18 app from jj9987 (official postgres:18 image) and SeaweedFS-Mnema from this repository. Then you need a domain with HTTPS through a reverse proxy. Guide: https://github.com/mnema-xyz/talk/blob/main/doc/platform-notes.md#install-on-unraid-via-community-apps
Container.Overview: Your own place to hang out: text channels, drop-in voice Talks, video and screen sharing up to 4K at 60 FPS. One small self-hosted server for one community, on your own hardware, with your data staying with you. Mnema Talk keeps its data in PostgreSQL 18 and its media in S3 storage: install the postgresql18 app from jj9987 and SeaweedFS-Mnema first, then this one. Put a reverse proxy with HTTPS in front (for example Nginx Proxy Manager) and forward the voice ports on your router. Guide: https://github.com/mnema-xyz/talk/blob/main/doc/platform-notes.md#install-on-unraid-via-community-apps
Container.Description:
Mnema Talk is a small, self-hosted home for one community.
- Text channels, threads, DMs, polls, events and a wiki - Drop-in voice Talks, video and screen share up to 4K at 60 FPS - Web app, desktop app and bots, one Go binary - Runs fine on a NAS next to PostgreSQL and SeaweedFS
**Before you start:** install the postgresql18 app from jj9987 (user mnema, database mnema_talk) and SeaweedFS-Mnema. You need a domain with HTTPS (reverse proxy) and three router forwards: HTTPS, the UDP voice range 50000-50050 and port 3479 UDP and TCP. Never forward the web port itself. Generate each secret with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people open in their browser, with https://. Required.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web app. Point your reverse proxy at it. Never forward it on your router.

Config.Name: Voice UDP ports
Config.Description: UDP range for voice, video and screen share. Forward it on your router. Keep the host ports equal to the container ports.

Config.Name: Voice relay port (UDP)
Config.Description: Relay for members whose network blocks the UDP range. Forward it on your router. Keep the host port equal to the container port.

Config.Name: Voice relay port (TCP)
Config.Description: The same relay over TCP. Forward it on your router too.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Connection to PostgreSQL 18. Required. Format: postgres://mnema:DB-PASSWORD@UNRAID-IP:5432/mnema_talk?sslmode=disable (user, password and database as set in the postgresql18 app).

Config.Name: Media storage address
Config.Description: S3 address of SeaweedFS-Mnema: http://UNRAID-IP:8333. Required.

Config.Name: Media storage access key
Config.Description: The access key set in SeaweedFS-Mnema. Required.

Config.Name: Media storage secret key
Config.Description: The secret key set in SeaweedFS-Mnema. Required.

Config.Name: JWT secret
Config.Description: Signs login sessions. Required: paste the output of openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it; changing it logs everyone out.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Name of the first admin account, created on the first start.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password of the first admin account. Used once, on the first start; change it after you log in. Required.

Config.Name: Media bucket
Config.Description: Bucket for uploads; created on the first start.

Config.Name: Media storage region
Config.Description: Leave as is for SeaweedFS.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Default language of the server.

Config.Name: Reverse proxy address
Config.Description: Address of your reverse proxy container (for example 172.17.0.5), so real visitor addresses reach the server. One address, never a whole range.

Config.Name: Public IP or DynDNS name
Config.Description: Only if voice does not connect from outside: your public IP or DynamicDNS name. Empty = detected automatically.

Config.Name: Unraid LAN IP
Config.Description: The Unraid server's LAN address, so members at home reach voice without NAT loopback on the router.

Config.Name: Voice UDP port min
Config.Description: Change only together with the Voice UDP ports above.

Config.Name: Voice UDP port max
Config.Description: Change only together with the Voice UDP ports above.

Config.Name: Voice relay port number
Config.Description: Change only together with the two voice relay ports above.

Config.Name: Max upload (MB)
Config.Description: Largest file a member can upload.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Outgoing mail server for address confirmation and password reset. Empty = no e-mail.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: Empty = 587 with starttls, 465 with tls.

Config.Name: SMTP security
Config.Description: starttls for port 587, tls for port 465.

Config.Name: SMTP username
Config.Description: Mail account name.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: Mail account password.

Config.Name: SMTP from
Config.Description: Sender address, for example talk@example.com.
